content: Even the mightiest oak tree began as an acorn hidden in the darkness of the earth.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Taiboku mo mebuki kara — Folk Adage
explanation: When an acorn is buried in damp, pitch-black dirt, it might seem like a burial. In truth, it is planting. The season of obscurity and darkness is not punishment; it is the necessary gestation period where the seed cracks and roots anchor deep before touching the sky.
practicalInsight: If your current efforts feel unseen or uncelebrated, do not despair. Focus on growing your roots deep in silence.
reflectionPrompt: How can you view your current period of quiet striving not as a dead-end, but as an essential season of hidden rooting?
